notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power eight or greater.
Selvala and Chulane do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}{W}.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Village Bell-Ringer from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Village Bell-Ringer by paying {2}{W}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card, then allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
